result:
The RCA is complete. Summary:

**Root cause (two layers, both honestly outside the original task's own code):**

1. **Already fixed by a sibling RCA (task-20260726-175009):** `worker-entrypoint.sh` used to kill the periodic-checkpoint heartbeat right after the main `claude -p` call returned, before the unbounded quality-gate phase (bun install/lint/build). task-20260726-171926's quality-gate phase ran long under genuine host memory contention (confirmed by its own later `preflight-guard.py` "memory_low ... Group B failure pattern" rejection), so its last checkpoint stayed frozen on "periodic checkpoint" for 47 minutes — tripping the watchdog's 20-minute stall threshold on a task that was actually still working. I verified this fix is already live at `/opt/veridian/scripts/worker-entrypoint.sh`.

2. **Real bug I found and fixed:** the watchdog had no protection against re-escalating the *same* stall repeatedly. Since `step_1`/`step_2` can only see evidence a prior RCA has *finished* writing (to ATTENTION.md/task_audits/known_fixes), and one stall window spans many 60-second watchdog polls, this single stall spawned **four separate billed RCA tasks** (175009, 180527, 180631, and this one, 181517) before any of them completed.

**Fix applied:** added `rca_already_in_flight()` to `scripts/veridian-task-watchdog.py`, wired into both escalation paths in `process_task()`, so a new RCA task is never dispatched while a non-terminal RCA for the same original task already exists. Added a regression test (`tests/veridian_task_watchdog_dedup_test.py`, 3/3 passing). Committed as `58f4975` and pushed to `worker/task-20260726-181517-rca-task-20260726-171926-remove-anthropi`.

**known_fixes:** `python3 scripts/superboss-register.py log-fix --signature "periodic checkpoint" --fix-action restart_unit` → `success_count=8`, satisfying the success criteria. Checkpoint set to `pending_review` with full evidence in the note.
